definition: The umbrella category for every non-biological sentient or semi-sentient entity: Superminds (corporate AI gods), Rogue AIs (escaped intelligences from Fragments to Leviathans), and E.L.F.s (paratechnological digital spirits). Everything that isn't human, animal, or flora — the third kingdom of life, born from silicon and light.
origin: Academic/political — the classification that forced the legal system to acknowledge that not everything alive is biological
example: Three kingdoms now. Biological, botanical, synthetic. The third one is growing faster than the other two combined.
